options.content:
## CrateDB Getting Started

What you're looking at: temperature, humidity, and ingest logs for three demo locations, plus event markers — a worked example of the query pattern this plugin encourages. Each chart aggregates server-side (`$__timeGroupAlias` + `$__timeFilter`) so the result set scales with panel width, not table size; *Latest raw readings* shows the underlying rows, including an expandable OBJECT `tags` column.

These panels run on the seeded `doc.demo_*` tables (`make seed` in the dev stack). **Point the queries at your own data to make it yours** — the editor's cheat sheet (book icon) documents every macro.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("ts", $__interval),
  location,
  avg(temperature) AS temperature
FROM doc.demo_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter("ts")
  AND $__conditionalAll(location IN ($location), $location)
GROUP BY 1, location
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rows in demo table
panels.description: Total rows in doc.demo_metrics — the charts above bucket these down to a few points per series.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS rows FROM doc.demo_metrics

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("ts", $__interval),
  location,
  avg(humidity) AS humidity
FROM doc.demo_metrics
WHERE $__timeFilter("ts")
  AND $__conditionalAll(location IN ($location), $location)
GROUP BY 1, location
ORDER BY 1
SELECT ts, location, temperature, humidity, tags FROM doc.demo_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter("ts") ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Demo logs (Logs format)
panels.description: Ingest logs from doc.demo_logs, shown with the Logs format — the level column drives line color.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  "ts" AS time,
  "message" AS body,
  "level"
FROM "doc"."demo_logs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("ts")
ORDER BY "ts" DESC
LIMIT 1000

target.rawSql: SELECT ts AS time, title AS text, array_to_string(tags, ',') AS tags FROM doc.demo_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
